title: Emergency Contact Drill Freshness
dataSources: Daily activity (`eldercare:activity`), fall alerts (`fall:alert`), medication reminders (`medreminder:event`), check-in calls (`checkin:call`), wandering alerts (`wandering:alert`).
app: Elder-care and accessibility telemetry — activity and fall sensors (Apple Watch fall detection, motion mats), medication dispensers, and check-in / video-call logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and smart-home hubs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=checkin:call call_type=emergency_drill
| stats max(_time) as last_drill by resident
| eval days_since_drill=round((now()-last_drill)/86400,0)
| sort - days_since_drill
description: Checks how recently each resident completed a planned emergency contact or drill call.
value: Emergency procedures only help when practiced and remembered, not just written down.
implementation: Tag planned drill calls separately in `checkin:call`; calculate days since each resident's last drill.
visualization: Table of residents by days since emergency contact drill.
grandmaExplanation: It warns how long it has been since emergency calling steps were actually practiced.
